blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Citing “religious grounds,” the co-host of Sen. Rodante Marcoleta in his NET25 program will no longer testify against him before the Sandiganbayan Third Division in his plunder bail hearing over a P75 million campaign donation. Witness Nelson Lubao, through his counsel, filed a motion to be excused from taking the witness stand against his brethren Marcoleta, a prominent Iglesia Ni Cristo member.
